plan.question: Does the proposed arithmetic area-mixed coefficient improve small-interface-shift wave accuracy against an independent analytic solution, compared with binary and reciprocal mixing?
plan.why_replaces_previous_step: independent exact reference and competing mixing law replace same-solver two-grid self-comparison; original 2D plan preserved but not selected for execution
plan.continuous_pde: gamma*u_tt = c^2 * d_x(gamma*d_x(u)); flux gamma*d_x(u) and u continuous at interface

analytic_derivation.scope: displacement for this scalar PDE, not a pressure reflection formula

initial_rightgoing_gaussian.initial_states: exact piecewise analytic field at t=-dt and t=0; zero external forcing

plan.boundary: unchanged reflecting ghost-cell rule; fixed reflection window precedes boundary returns, verify travel times before execution
plan.strong_simple_baselines: fixed-grid binary with phase-aware labels; same-grid reciprocal mixture; finest-grid binary reference with measured extra cost; analytic solution evaluation only
plan.observation: same physical receiver via linear nodal interpolation, common coarse time samples; no fitted gain, delay, truth-driven window or noise inflation
plan.discretization: 1D restriction of existing harmonic-face coefficient and gamma mass update; single-step check against y-invariant 2D operator before main simulations
primary_metrics: relative reflected trace error versus exact analytic reference, separately by representation/grid/phase
shifted-minus-base wave error normalized by exact shifted-minus-base wave norm
elapsed time, grid steps and memory

screening_gates.threshold_status: engineering screen, not instrument requirement or publication standard

decisions.linear_area_pass: retain only as candidate for later 2D validation; not proof of 2D inverse resolution
decisions.reciprocal_beats_linear: inspect interface mass/flux consistency; do not automatically transfer arbitrary coefficient smoothing into inversion
decisions.all_coarse_models_fail_but_refined_binar: retain grid-defined baseline and quantify refinement cost; no neural necessity established
decisions.reference_or_operator_validation_fails: inconclusive implementation test, preserve and count failures

plan.execution_requirements: freeze code hash before any solve; count all attempts and short checks; no automatic changes to phases, windows or thresholds

expected_time_to_next_stage.stage: retain or reject arithmetic area-mixed coefficient for a later 2D candidate pipeline
expected_time_to_next_stage.solver_estimate: seconds to a few minutes for 1D; not measured yet
expected_time_to_next_stage.not_covered: 2D localization accuracy, external measurement, scientific novelty or publication-ready conclusions

implementation.binary_interface_convention: node x >= xi belongs to right material
implementation.gamma_ghosts: ones, matching original padded material convention
implementation.sample: output at (step+1)*dt, downsample native fine traces at factor-1::factor
implementation.initial_state: piecewise analytic sharp-interface field for all methods; residual initial difference between alias phases reported
implementation.performance_scope: 1D float64 benchmark; no GPU speed or 2D accuracy claim
